text.title: LS / Gumroad Pricing Flip Decision Tree
text.summary: Routes on conversion volume in the comparison window, on whether the store records a variant id per order, and on whether the window is exclusive to the price change — to a full flip record, a confound-declared record, or skip.

decision-tree.root-question: Does each side of the comparison window hold roughly 30 or more paid conversions?

conclusion.verdict: skip; the difference will sit inside noise whatever the arithmetic says — flip on judgement and do not write a measurement record

branch.question: Does the store's webhook or export persist a variant/product identifier per order (LemonSqueezy `variant_id` on `order_created`, Gumroad product/variant id)?

conclusion.verdict: halt; wire the webhook or export to persist the variant id before flipping — timestamp-derived cohorts cannot be reconstructed after the fact

branch.question: Is the price the only change in the window, and is the price actually free to move (no enterprise, regulated or annual-commitment contract)?

conclusion.verdict: skip; contractually fixed pricing is not flippable — the record would document a change that cannot ship
apply only with the confound written into the record and the design labelled `sequential`; otherwise move the flip to a clean window
apply the full record: net payout not sticker price, explicit grandfathering verdict, refund-window policy for a cut, and every price-bearing surface enumerated with its owner
